verdict.rationale: Brex documents instant virtual card creation, including one-click virtual cards inside Bill Pay for paying vendors, and procurement spend limits, which together approximate per-vendor cards. However, no evidence shows a card can be locked to a single merchant or vendor, so the isolation guarantee in the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented merchant/vendor locking on virtual cards, explicit SaaS-subscription card workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of vendor-isolated cards.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can create single-vendor virtual cards for SaaS subscriptions and procurement so one compromised vendor never exposes shared credit
